seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [player,target,wall] show mixed outcomes: pixels,w,y x1, pixels,y x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Two axes (h row band, v col band; v drawn over h) + holed 3x3-block pieces; A5 cycles h->v->pieces(by min block)->h; A1/A2 move h axis or piece rows -+3, A3/A4 v axis or piece cols -+3 (axis moves ignore pieces; piece bounded to board).
Reflections: each piece block mirrored across v (visible gray), across h and both (invisible occluders; centre hole shows lower pixel); reflections on piece blocks dropped.
Render cell stacks (wall<target<reflection<piece; selected sprite fills holes with 0 only if nothing solid below) then re-extract 4-conn comps; wall/player comps include all 0 cells and dot-only comps consume an index; wall prefix v iff bbox w>=h.
Reflection ACTION3 mixed outcomes = invisible H/HV reflections occluding targets and re-ranking reflection indices (they count in ranking, not output), not a reflection field. Targets: 4-conn comps merged when bbox gap<=4.
Unconfirmed (no observations): piece-vs-piece blocking, V-vs-H reflection overlap priority, piece cycle order beyond fi
